messages:
lina: quick heads-up — rolling a small onboard drip for new signups next week. goal: 3 emails over 10 days, lightweight product tips + invite to intro webinar. looking for copy + segment timing input.

sam: love it. do we want to micro-segment by signup source (docs, api key, webinar) or keep it simple?

maria: i'd recommend micro-seg by source for the first 24-48h cadence only. docs/api users get product tip first, webinar signups get webinar reminder + resources. rest go into core nurture.

nate: ops question — what's the send window per timezone? APAC vs NA vs EMEA. we should stagger to avoid spike on our transactional pipeline.

lina: plan: NA 9am local, EMEA 10am local, APAC 11am local. bursts limited to 500/hr for first day. nate can you confirm throttles?

nate: confirmed — will set rate limit in the send job and add a fallback to queued status if quota reached. will post the job id when scheduled.

maria: draft copy for three sends below — pls quick review. subject variants included.

maria: ```
email 1 (day 0):
  subj A: Welcome to Redwood — get your first gen in 5 minutes
  subj B: Quick start: builder-friendly LLM inference with Redwood
  body: 1-line welcome, 2 bullets: hosted API quickstart, playground link, CTA: try the quickstart

email 2 (day 3):
  subj A: Tips to cut inference cost by 2x
  subj B: Optimize latency: small config changes that matter
  body: 1 tip + example config snippet, link to Optimize guide, CTA: see cost savings calculator

email 3 (day 10):
  subj A: Live intro webinar — ask the infra team anything
  subj B: RSVP: quick tour of Redwood's serving runtime
  body: 2 bullets on what we cover, date/time, CTA: RSVP
```

sam: copy looks solid. recommend A/B subject test on email 1 only, then pick the winner for rest. also add an RSVP fallback in email 3 for different time zones.

lina: good call. maria — can you add RSVP fallback + a short 1-line testimonial from a customer? keeps social proof light.

maria: added: "Companies like EchoAI cut inference cost 30%" — short and verifiable. will update the draft and push to Google drive. link: https://drive.redwood.company/marketing/onboard-mini-drip (private)

nate: deploy-bot: scheduled send job created -> job/78921; initial throttle 500/hr NA, 300/hr EMEA, 200/hr APAC. will monitor first 24h.

deploy-bot: job/78921 status: queued -> scheduled for 2024-06-10T13:00:00Z (NA start).

lina: awesome. next steps: maria finalizes copy + link to drive by EOD tomorrow, sam to set up subject A/B in ESP, nate to confirm throttles and pickup monitoring dashboard, i'll run QA on links and tracking.

sam: I'll add campaign tags: campaign=onboard-mini-2024, channel=email, variant=A/B. will post ESP link when ready. :rocket:

maria: updated doc live and added alt testimonial lines. posting here for final eyes: https://drive.redwood.company/marketing/onboard-mini-drip/v2

lina: final ask — keep the CTAs single and track clicks per segment. we'll review metrics day 4 and day 14. thanks y'all :thumbsup:
